user_reported_bug: pomodoroda süreyi başlatınca ve başka yere girince süre duruyor ya da sıfırlanıyor pomodoroya basınca en yukarıda süre başlasın ufak bir tane göz yormayan
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI verification showed the Pomodoro countdown no longer stops/resets when closing the panel, switching ToolsBar panels, navigating to /settings and back, or refreshing; mini pause/resume and reset also work. Remaining issue: while the timer continues across /settings, the requested small top mini indicator is not visible on the /settings page (pomo-mini count = 0), so the 'always visible at top after navigating away' part is only partially implemented.

ui_bugs.issue: When a Pomodoro is running and the user navigates to /settings, the timer state continues, but the small top indicator is not rendered (data-testid='pomo-mini' count was 0). This leaves the user without the requested top timer after navigating away from Dashboard.

issues: PomodoroMini is mounted only in Dashboard.jsx; Settings.jsx has its own header without PomodoroMini, so the mini timer is not app-wide.

action_items: Mount PomodoroMini in a shared protected app header/layout, or add it to Settings/Admin headers, so the small top timer remains visible on protected routes while running/paused mid-cycle.
critical_code_review_comments: PomodoroContext.js correctly stores timer state globally and persists endAt in localStorage, which is why countdown survived panel unmounts, route navigation, and refresh in testing.
PomodoroMini.jsx works on Dashboard and can pause/resume without opening the panel, but Dashboard.jsx is currently the only page that renders it; Settings.jsx does not import or render PomodoroMini.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin@dersim.app / Admin123! account and cleared only Pomodoro localStorage keys during the UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repeat the focused Pomodoro UI flow after moving/rendering PomodoroMini globally: start at 25:00, close/switch tools, verify mini ticks, navigate to /settings and confirm mini remains visible there, return to /, refresh, mini pause/resume, then reset hides mini.
rca_of_the_issue: The original reset/freeze root cause is fixed by moving timer state from Pomodoro.jsx into PomodoroContext.js with a persisted wall-clock endAt. The remaining visibility issue is architectural: PomodoroMini is rendered inside Dashboard.jsx only, while /settings uses a separate header without that component. Repro: login -> open Pomodoro -> Başlat -> navigate Ayarlar -> [data-testid='pomo-mini'] is absent even though countdown continues when returning.
